csv_project_name: Consultant for West Ashley Future County Park Master Plan
csv_scope_of_work: Charleston County Park & Recreation Commission (CCPRC) is requesting proposals from qualified Architecture, Planning, Engineering or Landscape Architecture firms, or a consultant team (hereinafter referred to as Proposer ) to provide preliminary master planning services for the approximately 1,951-acre future Bulow County Park (name subject to change), located off of Bear Swamp Road in West Ashley (Charleston), SC. The property includes the following Charleston County Parcel ID/TMS #s 301-00-00-007, 287-00-00-311, 287-00-00-312, 287-00-00- 280). The initial planning process will be broken into two tasks: - Task 1 Preliminary Master Planning - Task 2 Engineered drawings and permits for lake construction (Task 2) Access is provided to the property via Hughes Rd., Bear Swamp Rd., a future Bear Swamp Rd. Extension, and an easement across a City of Charleston future park parcel (TMS #287-00-00-001). CCPRC currently operates an event venue with lodging accommodations called The Lake House at Bulow (by reservation only), located at 926 Hughes Rd. The properties are in the 29455 zip code, in unincorporated Charleston County.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Planning/Master Planning
